Candidate names HERMES-MAKER and GLM checker strings; those strings are not proof of process independence. No maker/previous checker PASS or digests inherited. Strict mutation inventory exceeded by required CLI checker.

results.description: HEAD and HEAD tree match the supplied frozen candidate. The checkout began with three modified tracked artifacts. Released tag resolves to 8faa64e581e8c25f5ec355475e29561847da3ead; no release mutation was performed.

40 changed files, 36 outside the four-file allowlist, including .hgk governance/evidence/old receipts and openspec/changes/pipd-ls-sp-s4-postrelease-narrow-repair/tasks.md. Runtime src/schemas/tools/skills did not change between old/new candidates.
Ran 389 tests in 119.599s; OK (skipped=3), exit 0. Candidate checkout, pinned Python 3.11.9, PYTHONPATH=<candidate>/src. Suite status contains just the three pre-existing/authorized artifact paths.

Base was exported with git archive and tar, without checkout. Ordinary discovery: 318 tests, failures=7/errors=19/skipped=3. Windows long paths prevented some setUpClass cases. Extended-path discovery: 325 tests, failures=11/errors=2/skipped=3. Eight failures require Git truth/history (one RepoContext mode assertion, one evidence-manifest HEAD assertion, six TT summary assertions); three additional crosswalk failures arise from forward slashes under extended Windows paths; two wheel assertions raise commonpath drive mismatch between extended and ordinary paths. A separate freshly archived base with local shared Git history (clone --no-checkout, update-ref/read-tree only) ran 325 tests with failures=3/errors=2/skipped=3, removing the eight history-dependent failures. These failures occur on the base and do not demonstrate a candidate regression. The operator base claim 325 OK is NOT independently established. No shorter physical scratch path or test modification was used.
Exactly four new test files were added relative to base; no pre-existing tests modified.
19/19 field-exact registry; eight skill packs PASS; CLI exact 13/13; 19 *.schema.json files. CLI checker has a tracked output side effect, separately recorded.

Regex-extracted block is byte/text exact and first line starts set -e. Activation has POSIX/Windows fallback. Fresh retry pip-less run exits 1 at python -m venv, without activation/pip install/pipd. Working Python 3.11 run exits 0; doctor PASS and package resolves under scratch .venv/Lib/site-packages. No global install. Wheel fetched from authorized release URL; checksum-list transport supplied locally. Initial two runs stopped at a harness curl path error and were not used as quickstart verdict evidence.

Regex-extracted unmodified block dot-sourced from a pwsh -NoProfile -File transport wrapper; first code line ErrorActionPreference=Stop. Fresh pip-less retry exits 1 at explicit venv guard, without a command-not-recognized cascade or pip install. Working retry exits 0, doctor PASS, package under scratch venv. Minimal script observes pwsh 7.6.5, PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference=False, native Python exit 7 followed by CONTINUED and script exit 0: guards are needed on this host default. Initial working attempt stopped at pip because offline wheelhouse lacked typing_extensions; corrected harness adds cached wheels, fresh retry succeeds.

README claim is bounded to identical rooted inputs and no stronger than these executions: actual driver twice into sb-a, once sb-b, all exit 0. PI/PD/ECP/TQAEP file and content hashes plus bundle digest identical for same root; PI/TQAEP identical for different root, PD/ECP and bundle differ. Intent card also unchanged. Only claims these supplied inputs/roots, not universal compiler semantics. Driver rewrote digests.json and negative_stale_context.txt; both recorded modified, not restored.

Frozen commit archive scan covers 1269 files. Runtime secret patterns have zero hits. Broader sk-shape scan finds 16 occurrences on 14 lines: identifier-tail fixture and its documentation/governance snapshots, all false positives. No credential values printed or used. This is a bounded regex sweep, not source/supply-chain certification.

582 term occurrences inventoried; each classified below. Hits are ceiling disclaimers, enums, test/adversarial data, planned/policy levels, or quoted historical evidence. No present live grant identified. HUMAN_RELEASE has zero hits. The shipped adversarial mount example is an attack example followed by refusal, not acceptance.

Fresh probes reproduce all three: rehashed ECP.permission.scope=** validates PASS/4/0 findings; unvalidated _profile_meta injected claims PASS/4/0; PI trace=[] PASS/4/0 without rehash. TT names F04/F05/F06 as OPEN, severity BLOCKER/NON_BLOCKING/NON_BLOCKING. Repair runtime diff empty: no silent fix. Disclosures match measured limitations; F04 remains a blocker to acceptance despite disclosure.

Three newly designed probes: unrehashed permission widening correctly rejected SEMANTIC; forged PI trace to_id accepted; rehashed checker alias equal to maker after whitespace/case normalization accepted. Repeated previously failed F04, F05, F06; repairs leave those limitations unchanged. Empty bundle control correctly refused. No executor or real permission grant invoked.

Six tracked files modified at end. Three were already dirty and are suite-authorized; two example outputs are driver-authorized; CLI_SURFACE.json is additional and not authorized in the side-effect list. Diff changes candidate_head only, from 7c5bc585... to current subject. Required CLI checker writes this file. No restoration was performed. HEAD tree remains expected e95e33f008a617faef8881431b27a468f516d409. HEAD tree identity does not prove a clean working tree. Ignored files were not byte-snapshotted, so universal filesystem non-mutation is not attested.

# Self-bootstrap example (source-constrained)

WorkOrder: `WO-S4-SELFBOOT-04` (`POSTRELEASE-20261011-s4-narrow-repair`). Candidate-only.

This example drives **this repository's shipped CLI** through the real compiler chain

    intent -> compile-pi -> bind-pd -> compile-ecp -> compile-tqaep -> validate

using a frozen intent card, a self-contained clause-source file, and a minimal read-only
`RepoContext`. Nothing is hand-authored: the transcript and the negative output are the **raw**
stdout/stderr/exit of an actual run, and every digest is recomputed from that run.

## What this proves

* The repository is **self-bootstrapping on the positive path**: a fresh, isolated workspace can be
  created (`init`) and driven through the documented commands with no interactive input and no
  model on the compilation path.
* The chain is **replay-deterministic for identical rooted inputs**: no timestamp enters a digested
  field, so the **same intent, the same clause source and the same `RepoContext.root`** produce
  identical artefact digests across runs (`digests.json`). The determinism is bounded on purpose:
  PD binds an absolute `RepoContext.root` **by design**, and ECP is derived from PD, so a *different*
  root legitimately yields different PD and ECP digests while PI and TQAEP stay identical. That is
  **environment binding, not nondeterminism** — the same inputs at a different root are not the same
  inputs.
* Refusals are **typed and non-zero**: a missing source locator is refused `AUTHORITY_UNKNOWN`, and
  a stale `RepoContext` is refused `STALE_PROVIDER`; both are captured verbatim in
  `negative_stale_context.txt`.

## What this does NOT prove

* **Not independent acceptance.** The TQAEP record is a *design-time* candidate
  (`claim_ceiling = TQAEP_DESIGNED`); a checker receipt string is recorded, not verified. A live S5
  runtime checker must re-run it before any independent acceptance is claimed.
* **Not a release.** No commit, push, tag or release is produced; this is a candidate artefact.
* **Not the whole lifecycle.** Only the S1 LITE vertical slice is exercised. S0 source freeze, S2
  technology admission, S3 surface/GENIE projection and any runtime stage are out of scope.
* **Not the external standard.** It does not restate, re-derive or copy any body of
  `PIPD-LIFECYCLE-SPEC@1.1.0`, the Blueprint, the 11 packages or the 10 documents; it only binds a
  self-contained local clause source (see `docs/NORMATIVE_SOURCE_MAP.md`).
* **Not a claim of correctness of the repository's own logic.** It shows the pipe runs and refuses
  the two named negative cases; it is not a proof of the compiler's semantics.

## Layout

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `input/intent.json` | minimal intent card (goal + one source locator) |
| `input/source_clauses.txt` | the self-contained clause source the atoms are compiled from |
| `input/repocontext.json` | minimal read-only RepoContext template |
| `run_selfbootstrap.py` | the driver (creates the workspace in an isolated root, runs the chain) |
| `digests.json` | recomputed digests of the actual run |
| `transcript.txt` | REAL stdout/stderr/exit of the positive run |
| `negative_stale_context.txt` | REAL output of the two negative cases |

## Run

```
PYTHONPATH=<repo>/src <interpreter> examples/self-bootstrap/run_selfbootstrap.py \
    --root <disposable-dir-outside-the-repo>
PYTHONPATH=<repo>/src <interpreter> examples/self-bootstrap/run_selfbootstrap.py \
    --root <disposable-dir> --negative missing-source     # expect non-zero, typed
```

`--root` is refused if it resolves inside the repository. The workspace is always created **outside**
the repository.

## Notes on non-interactive driving

One documented command, `compile-construction-contract`, is **not** a CLI subcommand (the 13-command
surface does not expose it), so it is exercised only through the pipeline API used by the unit test
`tests/test_postrelease_selfbootstrap.py`. This is stated here rather than silently skipped.
